<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אדר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917294_theRebbe_722" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_93_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917294_theRebbe_722__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the opening header for the maamar, including the Torah portion, date, and year.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos of Parshas Tisa,</t>
    <t s="2">the 16th of Adar,</t>
    <t s="3">5728</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the maamar is a transcription of an oral discourse.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">(A transcription)</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Parshas Tisa details the service of the incense offering in the Mishkan, emphasizing its severity and unique prohibitions.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"When you take [a census] etc.,"</t>
    <t s="1">behold, in this portion1</t>
    <t s="2">the matter of the service in the Mishkan and the Beis HaMikdash, which is called Mishkan,2 is explained,</t>
    <t s="3">the matter of the act of the incense offering,</t>
    <t s="4">for this was one of the primary services in the Mishkan,</t>
    <t s="5">and even though also in the preceding portion,</t>
    <t s="6">Parshas Tetzaveh,3</t>
    <t s="7">the matter of the incense offering is discussed,</t>
    <t s="8">and likewise in the following portion,</t>
    <t s="9">Parshas Vayakhel,4</t>
    <t s="10">but there it is discussed only in general,</t>
    <t s="11">and in this portion the matter is explained in detail,</t>
    <t s="12">namely the preparations for it,</t>
    <t s="13">and from what the incense offering was made,</t>
    <t s="14">and also the greatness of the matter in this,</t>
    <t s="15">and the negative commandments connected to it and the severity of the matter in them, and even the matter of the opposite of life for one who transgresses them,</t>
    <t s="16">and also this matter of the opposite of life is specifically explained in this portion, since here the severity of the matter is explained,</t>
    <t s="17">and although also regarding sacrifices there are several negative commandments, like [offering] unconsecrated animals in the courtyard and slaughtering outside [the Temple] etc.,</t>
    <t s="18">but this does not reach [the level of] the incense offering, which is so severe, even to the matter of the opposite of life for one who makes [an incense offering] in its likeness.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
